##  PAN / Reprint of PAN Card Change-Correction in PAN Data 
  * [हिंदी](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-reqfornewpan.html#hindi)
[ When should I submit the application in the form "Request for New PAN Card or/and Changes or Correction in PAN data"? ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-reqfornewpan.html#english-01)
You can submit the application in the form "Request for New PAN Card or/and Changes or Correction in PAN data" in the following cases:
  1. When you already have PAN but want a new PAN card,
  2. When you want to make some changes or corrections in your existing PAN details.

[ Are there any charges for the form "Request for New PAN Card or/and Changes or Correction in PAN data"? ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-reqfornewpan.html#english-collapseTwo)
The form is freely downloadable from Protean e-Gov-TIN website. It is also available with the TIN-FCs.
[ Are there any fees to be paid while submitting the form for "Request for New PAN Card or/and Changes or Correction in PAN data"? ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-reqfornewpan.html#english-collapseThree)
  1. **If Physical PAN Card is required:**  
While submitting PAN application form, applicant will have to indicate whether physical PAN card is required. If applicant opts for physical PAN Card, then physical PAN card will be printed & dispatched at communication address. The e-PAN card in PDF format will be dispatched at e-mail ID mentioned in PAN application form, if the same is provided. Fees applicable are as follows:-
